title: Kion Cloud Rule
description: A cloud rule enforces policies on cloud accounts by bundling IAM policies, CloudFormation templates, Azure ARM templates, compliance standards, and other governance artifacts.

pre_webhook_id.description: Webhook ID to trigger before rule application.

post_webhook_id.description: Webhook ID to trigger after rule application.

built_in.description: Whether this is a built-in cloud rule.

owner_users.description: Owner users of the cloud rule.

owner_user_groups.description: Owner user groups of the cloud rule.

aws_iam_policies.description: AWS IAM policy IDs attached to the rule.

aws_cloudformation_templates.description: CloudFormation template IDs attached to the rule.

azure_arm_template_definitions.description: Azure ARM template IDs attached to the rule.

azure_policy_definitions.description: Azure policy IDs attached to the rule.

azure_role_definitions.description: Azure role IDs attached to the rule.

compliance_standards.description: Compliance standard IDs attached to the rule.

gcp_iam_roles.description: GCP IAM role IDs attached to the rule.

service_control_policies.description: Service control policy IDs attached to the rule.

ous.description: OU IDs the rule is applied to.

projects.description: Project IDs the rule is applied to.

labels.description: Labels associated with the cloud rule.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the cloud rule was created.
